meta.title: Android Studio
meta.description: Android Studio for DSH: the per-session Android App/device/run/build workbench plus an IDE-grade code reader for Sidebar files (syntax colours, folding, outline, find, go-to-line, virtualization).

ui.title: Android Studio
ui.noSession: Android controls require this conversation's session ID and working directory; no other conversation is selected.
ui.noProject: The Android project could not be loaded.
ui.workspaceChanged: The session's project directory changed. The previous run configuration and task view were cleared; no old command was sent to the new project.
ui.runTitle: Build, install and run the selected Debug app
ui.signExisting: Sign an existing APK / App Bundle…
ui.manualVariantHint: Enter the complete Gradle variant when static discovery does not include it. Upload/hardening on-flavors are blocked.
ui.skipResourceHint: Only enable this when that Teyes resource-generation task is unavailable.
ui.start.app: Select an App module and its Debug variant.
ui.start.device: Choose an online device; accept its USB debugging authorization if requested.
ui.start.run: Press Run. Build output and launch status appear in the Run tool window below.
ui.noApplications: No statically recognized Android application module was found in this build root.
ui.devicesHint: This conversation's mounted toolbar checks devices every 8 seconds while the page is visible. A failed check keeps your selected device; Run never switches to another phone.
ui.noDevices: No ADB devices found. Connect a USB device or open Wireless connection below.
ui.state.unauthorized: Unauthorized — accept the device's RSA prompt
ui.jobRunningHint: Closing this inspector or conversation does not cancel the task. This conversation's toolbar restores its task status and output.
ui.jobObserveFailed: Task observation paused. The task may still be running; retry to recover its state.
ui.jobRestoreFailed: Task history is unavailable. Retry before starting another build or run.
ui.noBuildOutput: Build an APK/App Bundle or use Generate Signed APK / App Bundle from the Build menu.
ui.noRunOutput: Run the app from the toolbar. Installation and launch output appear here.
ui.lossy: Earlier output was truncated. The latest bounded output is shown.
ui.noLogcat: Select a device in the toolbar, then read its most recent logcat entries. Device logs are not cleared.
ui.artifact.empty: No artifacts in this view. Build a package or refresh the selected variant's outputs.
ui.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the path manually.
ui.wizard.description: Choose a target, configure signing, then review. No build or signing begins before you press Generate.
ui.wizard.targetHint: This workflow builds the selected target and signs it inside one Host-managed task. A device is not required.
ui.wizard.existingHint: Select a real artifact produced or discovered by this workbench, or explicitly enter an existing Host path.
ui.wizard.manualArtifact: Enter a different existing artifact path
ui.wizard.signingHint: Use an existing keystore. Password values remain on the Host, referenced only by environment-variable name.
ui.wizard.outputHint: The Host requires a new file inside this project. It never overwrites the source artifact or an existing output.
ui.wizard.reviewHint: Check the target and output path. Generate starts one build-and-sign task; no application is installed.
ui.wizard.existingReviewHint: Generate signs this exact artifact to the new output path and verifies the signature. It does not rebuild or install an app.
ui.wizard.invalidMode: Choose a supported build or signing workflow.
ui.wizard.invalidFormat: Choose APK or Android App Bundle.
ui.wizard.noArtifact: Choose an existing artifact whose extension matches the selected format.
ui.wizard.noKeystore: Enter the path of an existing keystore.
ui.wizard.invalidEnv: Enter ANDROID_* environment-variable names, not secret values.
ui.wizard.noOutput: Enter a new output path with the matching .apk or .aab extension.
ui.wizard.sameOutput: The signed output must be different from the source artifact.
ui.reason.projectLoading: Wait for the Android project to load.
ui.reason.unsafeVariant: Upload/hardening on-flavors are blocked. Choose an off/off variant.
ui.reason.debugOnly: Run requires a Debug variant. Release variants can be built from the Build menu.
ui.reason.busy: A task is active in this project. Wait for it to finish or stop it first.
ui.reason.noDevice: Choose a target device in the toolbar.
ui.reason.deviceUnavailable: The selected device is not online and authorized. Refresh devices or accept its debugging authorization.
ui.unexpectedResponse: The Host returned an invalid Android Workbench response.
ui.unknownCommand: Android Workbench is unavailable in this session.
ui.popupHint: Click to open · Esc or click outside to close
ui.signingIncomplete: Fill the keystore and alias first
ui.wizard.noPassword: Enter both signing passwords (they are used once and never stored)
ui.passwordOnce: Passwords are sent once to the signing process and never logged or stored.
ui.wifiDialogHint: Enter the device IP; the port defaults to 5555.
ui.syncHint: Runs the Gradle wrapper `tasks --all`: Gradle configures the project and lists tasks to read real variants. No assemble/bundle task runs, but project plugin code executes during configuration, which may write caches.
ui.syncFailed: Gradle sync failed — see the task output
ui.tasksDescription: Android build/run job output and history
